fact: Lady Bellicent 船抵 Abaingeat 港后急赴 Tur-an-Gonog（Tower of the Claw），因马夫笨手笨脚弄疼战马 Anbarr，用扇子打了他一记耳光。
anchor: she gave the foolish servant a blow across the face with her fan

fact: Bellicent 是 Abaingeat 最有权势市民（其子 Scaeth）的母亲，自 Hernysadharc 乘船赶来报信。
anchor: even for Bellicent, the mother of its most powerful citizen

fact: 密信与 Scaeth 的印戒（signet ring）在 Knockbeg 被偷；Phelan 的宠物 starling-priest 已把密码抄成明文给他看。
anchor: his pet starling-priest copied the cipher out in plain words for him

fact: 偷信的是个小男孩，他爬上塔取走信件；他和带他去的“小农女巫”都没被抓到。
anchor: A little boy who climbed up to the tower and took it.

fact: Phelan 的士兵追到 Crannhyr 外的废矿，矿里全是 pucai（goblins），他们有两条狗（two of their dogs）被撕碎。
anchor: The mine was full of them. Two of their dogs were killed

fact: Scaeth 的密探报称：伪继承人 Ewain 几天前离开 Cashelrigg 东去投奔 Tethtain，Scaeth 怀疑 Father Rumon 插手。
anchor: the false heir Ewain has left to go to Tethtain in the east

fact: Scaeth 决定动手：Ewain 绝不能活着到 Dun Ard；伪继承人一死，他那“蹒跚的同父异母兄长”Phelan 也活不长。
anchor: Ewain must not reach Dun Ard alive, and once the pretender is dead

fact: Bellicent 疲惫不堪却不敢睡，怕梦见火与血，更怕“长在自己子宫里的那个东西”（指其子 Scaeth）。
anchor: the creature that had grown in her own womb
